fields.statement: Verifier (Opus) at c7fc3245: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestSessionMessage|TestTypePointer|TestQueuePointer' passes, including TestSessionMessageSaysWhyWaiting (a permission-blocked session gets exactly one stderr line with 'blocked on a permission: Bash' and 'rhiza inbox open'; the timeout error names 'last status: blocked on a permission: Bash') and TestSessionMessageSaysWhenStatusChanges (blocked then working mid-wait gives exactly two lines, the second ': working;' with 'waiting up to 1s'; the timeout names 'last status: working'). With GOTMPDIR in a scratch dir and RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset, go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/(session-message|session-message-busy|session-message-idle-fallback|session-hook-message|run-status-messages) passes; the leaf's commits touch no testscript or golden, so stdout and --json are unchanged. Diff read: typePointer prints only when the resolved status changes, to ctx.Stderr, and defaultMessageTimeout is still 10 * time.Minute.
